project_context.mood: Premium, professional athleticwear (like high-end Nike/Adidas), warm, grounded, authoritative.
project_context.core_changes: Transitioning from a dark-mode 'fintech-bro' look (deep navy + electric volt) to a premium light-cream and forest-green aesthetic.

mapping_old_to_new.text-white: text-ink (for headings) / text-gray-body (for body), except when on bg-ink

navbar.logo: Rebuild existing 'scout reticle' SVG using the new text-forest color. Wordmark: 'SCOUTMEPLAY' with 'ME' in text-forest. Tagline: small uppercase text next to logo.
navbar.layout: Sticky top, flex-row, UPLOAD VIDEO button on right (bg-forest text-white rounded-full pill) + square logout icon.

hero_paywall.layout: Grid (text left, image right). On mobile: flex-col with image below or above text (max-h-[80vh]).
hero_paywall.pill: Small gray rounded pill with lock icon, text 'PREMIUM'.
hero_paywall.headline: Ultra-condensed text-ink, uppercase, text-5xl to text-7xl. The number '9' colored text-forest.
hero_paywall.list_items: Thin-line green icons + dark gray text labels.
hero_paywall.cta_button: w-full bg-forest text-white rounded-full uppercase tracking-widest. Lock icon on the left.

feature_card_grid.cards: bg-cream-card (white) rounded-xl border border-gray-border shadow-sm p-6.

trust_strip.layout: 3-column flex/grid layout used consistently on the landing page and inside the report paywall.
trust_strip.content: Thin-line green icons above/next to bold uppercase headers ('TRUSTED & SECURE', etc.) and small subtext.

embedded_checkout_modal.wrapper: Repaint the wrapper modal from dark navy to bg-cream-card.
embedded_checkout_modal.branding: Change primary buttons inside the flow (if customizable) to forest green.

icons.instructions: Install `yarn add iconoir-react`. Use these icons for a thinner, hand-drawn look instead of standard Lucide. If Lucide is mandatory, use `strokeWidth={1.25}` or `1.5`.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 to gap-12 between sections.
layout_spacing.mobile_strategy: Content goes full-bleed, but text/cards maintain p-4/p-6 padding to prevent edge collisions. Navbar stays black on mobile.

hero_image.description: A goalkeeper in a green jersey stands ready on a rustic soccer field in Caldas, Colombia. Fits the forest-green premium aesthetic.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-video-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Run `yarn add iconoir-react` for thin-line hand-drawn icons.
Add the new colors (`cream-base`, `cream-soft`, `cream-card`, `forest`, `forest-pop`, `ink`) to tailwind.config.js.
Ensure `Barlow Condensed` (or a similar ultra-condensed font) is imported and applied to the heading class utility.
Do a global search-and-replace logically for `bg-deepnavy` -> `bg-cream-base` (except nav/footer) and `text-volt` -> `text-forest`.
Rebuild the 'scout reticle' logo as an inline SVG so it can inherit `text-forest` via `currentColor`.
Retain all functionalities (Stripe checkout, video scrubber, segment filters) perfectly while overhauling the visuals.
Apply the Trust Strip to the bottom of both the landing page and the report paywall card.
Always maintain WCAG accessibility for text on backgrounds (e.g. text-ink on bg-cream-base is perfect).
